newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures were called to open mostly unchanged Tuesday, dealers said.
Prices are expected to remain rangebound amid a continued lack of offtake and a neutral technical picture, analysts said.
Tuesday, March sugar closed at 10.42 cents a lb, off 0.03. Deferreds settled 0.03 lower to 0.06 higher.
LIFFE white sugar futures were slightly weaker early Tuesday, with spot March $0.30 lower at $299.40 and back months down $0.20 and $0.30 at 0838 EST/1338 GMT.
